component.name: CrossShell
component.summary: SSH both ways, files and remote desktop between Linux and Windows

description.p: CrossShell links your Linux machine and your Windows machine (or any mix of the two) on the same network, so they work like one desk.

ul.li: SSH both ways, set up for you: pair two machines with a 6-digit code shown on both screens. CrossShell exchanges keys and pins host keys, and afterwards ssh to the other machine works from any terminal.
Terminal tabs, a two-pane SFTP file manager and local and remote port forwards.
Remote desktop: view or control the other screen, with CrossShell's own engine tunneled through SSH, so it opens no extra ports.
